mismatch.message: a trap effect requires the redraw owner

summary: The admitted polymorph-trap replay stops when JS muse.c:use_misc calls seetrap with the game state instead of the required redraw operation. C use_misc calls seetrap(t), whose source implementation marks the trap seen and redraws the square through newsym. The canonical JS newsym function is already imported in muse.js; the bounded fix is to pass a redraw owner to seetrap while preserving a caller-injected redraw. The later mon.c:newcham gap is downstream and is not included in this diagnosis or scope.

source.branch: In use_misc's MUSE_POLY_TRAP branch, when the hero can see the monster or trap, call seetrap before the deliberate-jump message; seetrap marks the trap seen and redraws its square.

evidence: Accepted v52 evaluation hosted-38292091033-1-v52.json records this case as failed with error 'a trap effect requires the redraw owner'; the recording has 190 steps and its input/recording identity is pinned by the admitted v52 manifest.
Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/monmove.c:797-798 calls find_misc(mtmp), then use_misc(mtmp) when a miscellaneous action was selected.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/muse.c:2519-2539 handles MUSE_POLY_TRAP, conditionally calls seetrap(t), then emits the visible message and moves the monster onto the trap. Upstream trap.c:3578-3584 sets tseen and calls newsym when the trap was previously unseen.

JS js/muse.js:1607-1615 has the matching branch but calls seetrap(t, state). JS js/trap_effects.js:503-511 requires env.redraw before checking tseen, then updates tseen and invokes that callback. js/muse.js already imports the canonical newsym display operation.

After the redraw-owner defect is repaired, the branch still contains the explicit note_unported('mon.c newcham') call. That later behavior is outside this diagnosis and must not be represented as fixed by this task.
